### 2026-10-23 C23B immutable recovery: independent Drive backup readback

This is backup/provenance metadata only, **not a new scientific admission, test rerun or code change**.

- Scope: C23B source-frame/PW19 conditional finite research unit already published within this Draft PR. No production IVP, global convergence or full energy-closure claim.
- Git scientific checkpoint: `54477b285e0c712610453bca1408a076af43521d`; document checkpoint `a55734ba03e2fb74740e94da1eb622cdf4193fbe`. No force-push/merge.
- Immutable ZIP: `BASS_CR_C23B_SOURCE_FRAME_DELIVERY_20261023T122840KST.zip`, 5,264,742 bytes, SHA-256 `193a5fdc696fead363ac87a949aa7465fcaaf8d5de77dc097ad6a47dc96417f4`; manifest payload **453/453 PASS**, full ZIP CRC PASS on newly retrieved Drive bytes, payload bytes 11,575,141.
- **Google Drive**: create-only upload completed 2026-10-23, file ID `1wP4AQgvZB_4c8YBV_iFp2mGi0_Fk2QRi`; new whole-archive raw readback + local SHA-256 **PASS**, internal manifest 453/453 PASS.
- **Dropbox**: pre-existing file ID `id:BSpOijBcT10AAAAAAD_wZg`; Oct 23 frozen delivery receipt records an independent whole-archive raw readback and same SHA-256 **PASS_R3**; current check independently confirmed remote metadata and size, but did **not** re-download its full bytes again.
- **Tests**: only existing frozen C23B finite scientific/guard records; no numerical scientific tests were rerun in this backup audit.
- **Separate open item**: C22C 114,019,304-byte science ZIP still has prior verified Dropbox/Library backups but **no confirmed Google Drive full copy**. Original exceeds Drive file-size limit; attempted 8 MiB create-only chunks were blocked with `container_session_unavailable`. Do not mark C22C dual-cloud complete or re-upload blind.
- Production worktrees and running computations not touched; remote Desktop Commander execution remained quota-blocked, so unposted local state remains unobserved.
